model_annotation: This grouped bar chart illustrates the "effect" values across different language families for six model-metric combinations. The horizontal axis displays nine language family categories: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis is labeled "effect" and uses a linear scale ranging from approximately -5 to 30, with major tick marks at 0, 10, 20, and 30. Each language family group contains six bars corresponding to six conditions shown in the legend: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light pink/red), and XLM-B₂ (darker red). Each bar includes error bars indicating variability. For IE-Baltic, all bars are relatively small, ranging from roughly 1 to 6. For IE-Germanic, values range from approximately 1 to 15, with XLM-B₂ reaching around 15. IE-Indic shows the tallest bars overall, with mBERT-B₂ reaching approximately 24 and XLM-R₂ around 18. IE-Romance bars range from about 5 to 13. IE-Slavic values span roughly 2 to 17, with mBERT-B₂ being the tallest. IE-other shows values from about 5 to 15. Isolate has the smallest bars, all near zero, ranging from approximately -1 to 1. Semitic displays notable variability, with mBERT-L₂ at roughly 11 and XLM-B₂ reaching approximately 20, while some bars dip slightly below zero. Uralic bars are near zero or slightly negative, with large error bars. The bars within each group are arranged consistently in the order listed in the legend from left to right, and several bars—particularly in the Semitic and Uralic categories—feature notably wide error bars suggesting high uncertainty.
